name: fcdp
description: Chrome DevTools Protocol CLI for real and isolated Chrome runtimes

scripts.test: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:domains && npm run test:chromeos-lifecycle
scripts.test:syntax: python3 -m py_compile fcdp chromeos-host-relay.py tools/repro/fcdp-unrestricted-domains/*.py && bash -n fcdp-chromeos chromeos-entrypoint.sh fcdp-pipe tools/repro/fcdp-unrestricted-domains/*.sh && node --check bridge.mjs && node --check fcdp-pipe.mjs
